<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
आइ कोन दिन अछि?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
आइ सोमदिन अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
काल्हि कोन दिन होएत?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
काल्हि मंगलदिन होएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
काल्हि बृहस्पतिदिन होएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
परसू रविदिन होएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सप्ताहक सातू दिनक नाम कहू।
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
सोमदिन, मंगलदिन, बुधदिन, बृहस्पतिदिन, शुक्रदिन, शनिदिन, रविदिन।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
शनिदिन आ रविदिन छुट्टी होइत अछि?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हँ, शनिदिन आ रविदिन छुट्टी होइत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
आइ मंगलदिन अछि। स्कूल कखन छुट्टी होएत?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
शनिदिन आ रविदिनकेँ छुट्टी होएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model

<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model

<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model

<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<end_of_turn>

<end_of_turn>

<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model

<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model

<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model

<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model

<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model

<end_of_turn>

<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<start_of_turn>model

<start_of_turn>model

<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model

<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user

<start_of_turn>model

<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
